AgentContracts.description: Schema entry point; this grouping is not an agent message.
AgentContracts.title: AgentContracts

AgentInputInfo.description:
Persisted provenance of agent inputs, separate from evaluator telemetry.

Sensor driving still receives ideal simulated ego localization. Naming that
assistance prevents a camera/LiDAR run from implying a learned localization
stack, or a deterministic fixture from implying actual CARLA sensor data.
AgentInputInfo.title: AgentInputInfo

AgentIsolatedRuntime.description:
An explicitly selected independent Windows SDK prefix.

This declaration selects import/fingerprint behavior. It does not assert
that dependencies import, a catalogue capsule is authentic, or inference
works; the local model manager must verify those separately.
AgentIsolatedRuntime.title: AgentIsolatedRuntime

AgentRoadRaster.description:
Ego-aligned semantic map, not camera perception.

Classes: 0 background, 1 driving road, 2 sidewalk, 3 solid lane line,
4 broken lane line. Rows increase ego-right, columns increase ego-forward.
Payload is either flat row-major classes or lossless base64 uint8 bytes;
origin identifies the ego reference point.
AgentRoadRaster.title: AgentRoadRaster

AgentSceneContext.description: Versioned optional privileged scene context for SDK 1.1 agents.
AgentSceneContext.title: AgentSceneContext

AgentSceneObject.description: Privileged object state; transform is the measured world box center.
AgentSceneObject.title: AgentSceneObject

AgentSensorFrame.description:
One lossless, native-frame-associated CARLA camera or LiDAR sample.

Camera bytes are row-major BGRA uint8. LiDAR bytes are little-endian float32
quadruples (x forward, y right, z up, intensity) in the sensor's local frame.
Timestamp is relative to this episode's first observation.
AgentSensorFrame.title: AgentSensorFrame

BoundingBoxExtent.description: Positive half-lengths of an actor's bounding box, in metres.
BoundingBoxExtent.title: BoundingBoxExtent

BrakingEvent.description: Begin braking at a positive deceleration magnitude until stopped.
BrakingEvent.title: BrakingEvent

ControlAudit.description: Control ownership and scenario assistance for both new and legacy runs.
ControlAudit.title: ControlAudit

ControlIntervention.description: A recorded scenario-script influence on the ego's requested control.
ControlIntervention.title: ControlIntervention

DrivingOutcome.description: Navigation measurements separate from execution and safety outcomes.
DrivingOutcome.title: DrivingOutcome

DrivingTask.description:
Explicit navigation objective, independent of an actor's initial speed.

Framework routes use world-coordinate waypoints. Agent-owned navigation
supplies only a destination so the agent must plan the route itself.
DrivingTask.title: DrivingTask

EvaluationCoverage.description:
Counts of actual observations; empty actor lists are observed empty scenes.

A pair's TTC is evaluated even when its known trajectory has no predicted
contact. Missing geometry/velocity is not an evaluated pair.
EvaluationCoverage.title: EvaluationCoverage

HostedEvidenceV1.description:
The caller checks local availability; counts describe persisted metadata.

No path, download URL or transfer capability is published. A known recorded
frame count can survive a missing artifact without implying that it is zero.
HostedEvidenceV1.title: HostedEvidenceV1

enum: The experiment failed on this computer. Review its local diagnostics.
The finalized result is unavailable on this computer.
message.title: Message

RelativeSpawn.description:
Spawn in an anchor actor's local frame: x forward, y right, z up.

The simulation adapter resolves this placement after spawning the anchor.
These coordinates do not imply the position lies on a drivable road.
RelativeSpawn.title: RelativeSpawn

SafetyMetrics.description:
Null minima mean unavailable/no relevant interaction; never encode infinity.

Severity is an observed collision score (100), or a score from a completely
observed trace. Otherwise it is null. Settings preserve scoring provenance.
SafetyMetrics.title: SafetyMetrics

SpeedChangeEvent.description: Set an actor's target speed at simulation time trigger_time_s.
SpeedChangeEvent.title: SpeedChangeEvent

Vector3.description: CARLA coordinates: x forward, y right, z up; units depend on the field.
Vector3.title: Vector3
